covered: Normal current-term dispatch from a current configured peer increments receipt telemetry.
Stale terms, unknown message errors and unconfigured/removed peers do not refresh observations.
Configured learners are included; retained historical links create no receipt series while removed.
Unobserved or previous-term timestamps omit age series and expose observation0.
Local monotonic ticks are converted to seconds.
Both directions of actual mutual-TLS Raft traffic produce observed receipt metrics.
Existing mutual-TLS identity rejection and HA failover suites pass.
limits: Receipt may accompany a denied vote or rejected log match; not quorum or application health.
Counters last for physical link lifetime; unchanged links can retain observations across readmission in the same term.
No election, eviction or stale-peer timeout policy changed.
Source and loopback mTLS validation; ongoing full compaction binary was built before this telemetry change and is separate evidence.
